moments.author: David Ornstein
moments.quote: Folarin Balogun transfer from Monaco to Everton is off – he declined to sign after a deal sheet and medical issues.
moments.why: A major, surprising transfer collapse involving a US‑eligible striker that’s lighting up soccer/X timelines.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Thanasis Antetokounmpo is leaving the NBA to sign a three‑year deal with Greek club ARIS Thessaloniki.
moments.why: Unexpected departure of a known NBA player making waves in both sports and international basketball fans.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Tacko Fall has signed with the 76ers, marking his NBA return for the first time since 2022.
moments.why: Tacko Fall’s return to the NBA surprises fans and sparks nostalgia and excitement.

moments.author: Harrison Graham
moments.quote: Veteran OLB Kyle Van Noy is signing with the Vikings; he’ll start on practice squad with Brian Flores reunion.
moments.why: NFL vets reuniting and practice‑squad move that’s unexpected—an instant talking point among football fans.

moments.author: Fabrizio Romano
moments.quote: EXCLUSIVE: Leon Bailey to Olympiacos on a permanent deal until June 2029, verbal agreement reached, here we go!
moments.why: High‑profile football transfer scoop with long‑term contract in Europe’s summer window—going viral among fans.
